description: A white rectangular base with several upright white blocks sits on a green tabletop in front of a wall, with a small round cup-like piece near the front edge. The right hand stays resting on the base to steady it as the left hand reaches to the left-side upright stack, grasps the top block as a left-hand object, lifts it straight up, then carries it leftward and sets it down off the base, releasing it.
